nightfallclock.options.title: Nightfall Clock
nightfallclock.options.clock.tooltip: The day and time just above your hotbar. It turns gold from sunset until dark.
nightfallclock.options.duskWarning.toolt: At sunset (6:00 PM), "The sun's getting real low" appears above your hotbar for a few seconds.
nightfallclock.options.countdown.tooltip: After sunset, the clock counts down the seconds until it's dark enough for monsters to spawn outside.
nightfallclock.options.stormWarning.tool: When thunder starts, "Storm's rolling in" appears above your hotbar. Monsters can spawn in daylight during a thunderstorm.
nightfallclock.options.overworldTime.too: In the Nether and the End, the clock shows the Overworld's day and time, so you know what's waiting when you go back.
nightfallclock.options.position.tooltip: Where the clock sits: above the hotbar, where the dusk message shows, or in a corner of the screen.
nightfallclock.options.timeFormat.toolti: 12-hour (6:00 PM) or 24-hour (18:00). Auto follows your computer's region settings.
